summary: 8/8 acceptance criteria exercised. 6 backend pytest cases across 3 files (all passed) + 8 named browser checks (all passed, one re-run through the APP_URL ingress). No bugs found.

checks.name: onboarding-flow-reveals-dashboard
checks.evidence: Fresh localStorage session shows 3-step PT-BR onboarding (Passo 1/2/3 de 3); Continuar advances steps, final 'Começar' click clears overlay, sets cash-onboarding-seen=true and reveals home-page with saldo-livre-real-value.

checks.name: dashboard-shows-monthly-figures
checks.evidence: Home page renders saldo-livre-real-value, saldo-disponivel-value, entrou/gasto, stat-previsto-value, total-metas-value with entrou containing 'R$ 5.000'. Re-run passed both on localhost:3000 and through APP_URL https://responsive-expo.preview.emergentagent.com.

checks.name: test_summary_has_all_dashboard_fields
checks.evidence: GET /api/finance/period -> 200 {reference:2026-09}; GET /api/finance/summary?reference=2026-09 -> 200 with saldo_livre_real, saldo_disponivel, entrou, gasto, previsto, reserva_metas_mensal all numeric.

checks.name: manual-transaction-updates-totals
checks.evidence: Opened Novo lançamento dialog, entered 42,50 / Gasto / Mercado / Pix through the 3-step wizard, dialog closed on save, confirmation toast text containing 'lançamento' appeared, and monthly-balance-spent-value changed from its prior text.

checks.name: test_create_transaction_updates_month_totals
checks.evidence: POST /api/finance/transactions {value:137.77, category_name:Mercado, date:2026-09-20, payment_method:pix} -> 201; GET /api/finance/summary gasto increased by exactly 137.77; GET /api/finance/accounts?reference=2026-09 lists the new expense row. Negative-value POST -> 422 (validation).

checks.name: navigation-and-month-selector-work
checks.evidence: month-picker-previous/next-button change month-picker-value label and round-trip back to the original; nav-planning/nav-accounts/nav-insights/nav-home all render their respective *-page testid without console error.

checks.name: planning-lists-upcoming-in-due-order
checks.evidence: Planning page shows planning-total-value and planning-alert (saldo mínimo estimado); seeded rec-rent (dia 10) row appears above rec-energy (dia 15) row by bounding-box Y, i.e. ordered by due date.

checks.name: accounts-toggle-fixed-payment
checks.evidence: Contas page (tab Fixas) toggles fixed-account-payment-rec-energy aria-label between 'Marcar conta como paga' <-> 'Desmarcar conta paga', persists after tab switch to Gastos and back, then restored to its original state to preserve the seeded fixture.

checks.name: test_toggle_payment_marks_and_unmarks_fixed_account
checks.evidence: PATCH /api/finance/payments/{recurring_id} {reference:2026-09, paid:!original} -> 200, GET /api/finance/accounts reflects the flipped 'paid' flag for the selected month, then restored; PATCH with an unknown recurring id -> 404/422.

checks.name: accounts-shows-seeded-card-summary
checks.evidence: Contas page renders card-summary-card-nubank with brand 'Mastercard', number containing '4821', and a visible card-summary-total-card-nubank (comprometido no mês).

checks.name: insights-shows-subscriptions-and-comparison
checks.evidence: Insights page shows subscriptions-summary-value, category-comparison-title with insight-category-mercado current/previous values, and savings-suggestions-title block (empty-state text shown since seeded Mercado spend dropped, so no over-spend suggestion is expected).

notes: Matrix has 8 criteria; 11 artifacts were produced (3 criteria got both a browser check and a backend test because they are API-backed UI flows).
Fixture discipline: the accounts-toggle-fixed-payment browser check and its backend counterpart both flip the seeded rec-energy paid flag then flip it back, leaving state as found.
form_factor is desktop; all checks ran at 1280x720/800 default viewport.
